message: The aspect '{0}' cannot introduce member '{1}' into type '{2}' because it is already defined in type '{3}', and one of the two members is static while the other is not.
rationale: 'its IsStatic flag is opposite of the introduced member' uses API jargon and is ungrammatical ('opposite of the introduced member' instead of 'opposite to that of the introduced member'). The report sites compare existingMember.IsStatic with builder.IsStatic, which the new wording states in plain words.
